source_review.scope: Comparison against original enquiry wording, canonical cited passages/rows and workbook notes; original source-file hashes checked. Not independent human/scientific validation.
source_review.D01: S01 p.15 supports a conditional NIR/Raman feed-frame screening comparison. T01 rows 9/13 provide qualitative powder geometries with S01 Table 1 p.6 provenance. The output does not adopt the source passage's general fusion-improvement language as a guarantee; comparisons require independent material and customer criteria.
source_review.D02: S01 p.17 describes reflection for opaque/concentrated dairy and fat/protein reference modeling. S01 p.18 supplies transmission limitations for thick/fat-rich material. Reflection is a conditional candidate; no diluted stream or demonstrated customer performance is invented.
residual_notes: Some D01 source-excerpt limitations are editorially redundant, including a Raman-specific excerpt also listed under NIR.
Qualitative workbook rows are displayed verbatim in risks; their ratings/depths are comparison guidance, not measured customer performance or cable specifications.
D02 extraction retains an imprecise qualitative temperature phrase. Numerical ranges and thresholds remain unknown and require clarification.
Model-authored questions and study prose still require expert review; mechanical validation does not establish arbitrary prose entailment.

superseded_live_runs.finding: D01 model-authored case summary imported a source-study rotary-press detail; shared constraints also displaced explicit acceptance metrics in go/no-go wording.
superseded_live_runs.resolution: assessment-v3 builds the summary from validated customer values and always names error, bias, response time and robustness criteria. Regression added; both cases rerun successfully.
